implement.approach: Gap on BASE f250acd7 (INFERRED from code): privacy.ts already formats release/dist/source_revision (diagnosticsRelease, minimizeJavaScriptEvent), but runtimeConfig.ts ships nativeBuildNumber=null and sourceRevision=null, nothing at build time produces an identity artifact, and sentry.ts diagnosticsGate()/initializeDiagnostics() (sentry.ts:44-70, :295-300 on BASE) only read runtimeConfig — so an approved build could never pass blocked_identity, and any populated value would have had to be hand-edited/mutable. Fix: (1) bundle-xcode.sh runs the protected, unmodified scripts/release-identity.mjs --check --require-committed --json (the same validator fastlane runs) and writes version/build/bundle/gitSha/committed to a git-ignored src/config/releaseIdentity.generated.json before Metro bundles; refusal or uncommitted tree leaves no file. (2) config/releaseIdentity.ts parses that record fail-closed (committed===true, com.picklesensei, dotted version, integer build 1..99999999, 40-hex lowercase sha; frozen result; hostile getters → null) and applyGeneratedReleaseIdentity() completes RuntimeDiagnosticsConfig with nativeBuildNumber/sourceRevision, rejecting bundle/version mismatch or drift from already-populated values. (3) diagnosticsGate(config, generated) applies it AFTER transport/provider/disclosures/DSN/native-privacy gates and before diagnosticsIdentity(); initializeDiagnostics() passes generatedReleaseIdentity(). Existing optionsForDiagnostics/createErrorReporter/scrub paths untouched, so envelopes carry release=com.picklesensei@<version>+<build>, dist=<build>, tags.source_revision=<sha>, model/policy versions, and stay scrubbed. Build-phase behaviour VERIFIED on Linux: running the real bundle-xcode.sh (stubbed react-native-xcode.sh) against this checkout wrote {marketingVersion:'1.0',buildNumber:1,bundleIdentifier:'com.picklesensei',gitSha:<HEAD>,committed:true}, git status showed it ignored, and `npx react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false` succeeded both without the file (Metro emits a null dependency → reader returns null → blocked_identity) and with it (module inlined; logs metro-absent.log / metro-present.log).

Jest/Babel in this repo cannot execute the pre-existing `await import('@sentry/react-native')` in initializeSdk (Node reports 'dynamic import callback invoked without --experimental-vm-modules'), so the startup test pins gate output + provider-unloaded for blocked states rather than an active_js_only SDK init; no production code was changed for the test and no vm-modules flag was added.
Root ESLint ignores **/*.js by pre-existing config, so readGeneratedReleaseIdentity.js and buildSetup.test.js are Prettier-checked but not linted by the authoritative config.

The generated identity carries the validator's `committed` verdict only; an archive built from a dirty tree that somehow bypasses --require-committed would still be refused by the parser (committed must be true) — fail-closed, no fallback identity.
